messages:
maya_sales: Hey team — POC with FinEdge. They're hitting a 'dims mismatch' on our rerank endpoint when they pass embeddings from the embeddings endpoint. Blocker for go/no-go. Posting logs below.

alex_finedge: Logs from our side:
```
RequestID: r-0b9c3a2d
Endpoint: /v1/rerank
Payload: { "query_embedding": [...], "candidate_embeddings": [[...],[...],...] }
Error: Embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536, received 768
```

jordan_se: Thanks Alex. Two quick questions: which embedding model did you call and what SDK / client are you using?

alex_finedge: Using our internal wrapper that hits /v1/embeddings with model=embed-lite-v1.0 via our Python requests wrapper. We did a couple of experiments — smaller model returned 768 dims so that rings true. But we thought rerank would accept variable dims?

lee_solutions: Rerank expects the same embedding dimensionality that the rerank model was configured for. If your rerank pipeline was configured for 1536 (default for embed-large), passing 768 will cause that error. Two ways to fix: 1) call the 1536-dim embeddings model; or 2) reconfigure rerank to accept 768 (we usually only do that for full POC provisioning).

jordan_se: Also check batching: if you batch candidate embeddings as a single flattened vector accidentally we sometimes see shape errors that manifest as 'dims mismatch'. Are you sending candidates as a list of lists (each candidate -> vector) or as one concatenated list?

alex_finedge: We're sending candidates as JSON list-of-lists. Example: candidates = [[0.1,0.2,...], [0.5,0.6,...]] — matches how the SDK docs show it.

maya_sales: They also reported sporadic 429s when trying to rerank 5k candidates in one go.

lee_solutions: 429s are expected if you push >max_batch_size throughput. Rerank has batching window + per-request token limits. For large candidate sets we recommend streaming chunked reranks (e.g., score 200 candidates at a time and aggregate). We can also increase their Dedicated quota for the POC if needed.

jordan_se: Quick triage checklist:
- Confirm embedding model name used for query and candidates.
- Confirm rerank model config (expected dim).
- Check logs for request_id and raw shapes (we want to see len(embedding) for each item).
- Reproduce with curl minimal example.

alex_finedge: Repro with curl (what we ran):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-lite-v1.0","input":["doc1","doc2"]}'
```
Response shows vectors of length 768. Then we call rerank: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query_embedding": <768-vec>, "candidate_embeddings": [<768-vec>, ...] }'
```
We get the dims mismatch error back.

lee_solutions: That confirms it. If you want to keep embed-lite-v1.0 you can re-create the rerank config to expect 768. For POC speed I'd recommend switching to the 1536 model to avoid changing pipeline config. Try model=embed-large-v1.1 in your embeddings call.

alex_finedge: OK can try that. Any quick tips to avoid the 429s when we test large batch sizes?

jordan_se: For the POC: set candidate_chunk_size=200 and call rerank repeatedly, or use the /v1/rerank/stream endpoint (streaming reduces memory pressure). Also add exponential backoff on 429. We can temporarily bump their per-minute rate limit for the POC — Maya, can we authorize that?

maya_sales: Yes we can do a temporary quota bump for a 2-week POC. I'll coordinate with billing. Also need to send the pricing grid and a summarized security questionnaire (they asked for SOC2 + encryption at rest).

lee_solutions: One more subtle bug we've seen: if your wrapper accidentally base64-encodes vectors or converts to strings, the JSON decoder can coerce to nested strings and then the shape inference fails. Double-check content-types and that your client sends numeric arrays (no quotes).

alex_finedge: Good call — our wrapper has a transformation step for some other vendor integrations; will audit and try both switching to embed-large and sending numeric arrays.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rerank-config update submitted: cfg-2371 (expected_dim=1536) — created by lee_solutions — status: pending

jordan_se: If you want, I can run a quick repro on my side once you paste a minimal request body. If it still fails, paste the request_id and I'll pull the server logs (I can access the customer POC log bucket).

alex_finedge: Pasting minimal body now (trimmed vectors):
```
{
  "query_embedding": [0.01,0.02,...(1536 numbers)...],
  "candidate_embeddings": [[0.05,0.03,...], [0.02,0.99,...]]
}
```
If we switch to 1536 it should work.

lee_solutions: Next steps:
- Alex: try embed-large-v1.1 and resend sample, prioritize numeric arrays and chunks.
- Jordan: watch logs for requestID r-0b9c3a2d and share if things still fail.
- Maya: bump quota for two weeks and send pricing + SOC2 pointer to FinEdge.

maya_sales: I'll email FinEdge the pricing snapshot and the standard SOC2 summary doc today. Also scheduling a 30m call Wed to confirm success criteria.

alex_finedge: Thanks everyone — will report back after testing embed-large. Appreciate the quick triage :thumbsup:
